honesty_note: The checker was developed in this session; exploratory executions preceded the final adjudicated run. The expectations were written into the script before the final run, and the recorded report.json is that run's output.
falsifier: Re-run check_f1_rev13_reobserve.py at the same declared pins: falsified if any named row flips mechanically against rev13; if the F1-AMB-25 mismatch set does not reproduce; if a probe is found asserting STRONGER/WEAKER or reading a `relation` leaf; if the rev12->rev13 delta is not the 12 declared leaves; or if any declared pin moves T0->T1.
